summary: CyrusOne remains one current KKR/GIP-owned data-center platform under Cavalry Parent L.P. The repository omits GIP and overstates an inferred KKR Fund V attribution. BlackRock is the successor manager parent, not a second owner, exact consortium percentages are not public, and the possible 2027 IPO was exploratory rather than signed.
